observation_value_or_blocker: The primary nephronectin studies establish direct alpha8beta1-nephronectin recognition by complementary methods. The discovery study used soluble alpha8beta1-AP to probe embryonic/newborn mouse kidney extracts and recombinant nephronectin fragments, showed RGD-sensitive binding, alpha8beta1-dependent K562 adhesion, and alpha8beta1/nephronectin complex formation in kidney. The follow-up purified-protein study measured an apparent Kd of 0.28 +/- 0.01 nM for alpha8beta1-nephronectin, reproduced binding with the recombinant RGD-containing linker fragment, and mapped the auxiliary LFEIFEIER/EIE motif by deletion, alanine scanning, inhibition, and trans-complementation.

observation_value_or_blocker: In IEC-6 rat jejunal epithelial cells stably expressing human Y1R, Scatchard analysis of equilibrium 125I-PYY binding reported a Kd of approximately 0.2 nM and approximately 104,000 receptors per cell (Results, Fig. 1). PKC inhibitors blocked PYY-induced MAPK phosphorylation and PYY induced PKCepsilon membrane translocation (Figs. 4-5). Src-family and EGFR tyrosine-kinase inhibitors blocked the PYY-MAPK branch, and PYY increased EGFR tyrosine phosphorylation (Figs. 6-8). PYY stimulated growth of Y1R-expressing cells in an EGFR-kinase-dependent manner (Fig. 9).
